items.title: 甫修補的N-central資安漏洞疑似遭到利用
items.summary: 上週末N-able在一天之內發布兩次N-central更新，修補CVE-2026-86206、CVE-2026-86207，以及CVE-2026-86218（CVSS v4.0嚴重程度評分為6.9、7.7、10分），威脅情報公司Huntress提出警告，這些漏洞疑似都已遭到利用，IT人員應儘速套用最新的2026.3 Hotfix 4（2026.3.1.14）因應。

items.title: OpenVPN 修補8個漏洞，包含可能導致服務阻斷、執行惡意程式碼的高風險漏洞
items.summary: 開源VPN軟體OpenVPN近日發布資安公告，修補8個資安漏洞，包含3個高風險漏洞，涵蓋軟體核心可靠性層及Windows相關元件，影響2.6.22、2.7.6與以前版本，用戶應升級至已修補完成的2.7.7版。

items.title: Keycloak存在重大密碼重設漏洞，恐導致攻擊者接管帳號
items.summary: 開源身分與存取管理伺服器專案Keycloak近日發布資安公告，揭露涉及身分驗證程序的重大漏洞CVE-2026-18963，除了影響Keycloak自身的上游版本外，同時也影響Red Hat Build of Keycloak（RHBK），Keycloak用戶應升級至已修補完成的26.7.2版，RHBK用戶則應視使用的分支版本升級至26.4.15或26.6.6版

items.title: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制
items.summary: 隨著生成式AI導入企業的速度加快，機敏資料外洩的防護與影子AI的治理已成為企業與資安業者共同的課題。除了國際科技與資安大廠積極布局AI Security，這幾年來，臺灣陸續有業者投入相關產品發展，中華資安國際也是其中之一，今年上半年正式進軍這塊市場，7月正式推出名為「AI安檢通道（AI Archway）」的產品。

items.title: 富爾特子公司格帝控股遭勒索軟體攻擊，ERP等系統一度無法運作
items.summary: 上市公司富爾特（6136）提供數位化平臺服務，業務涵蓋電信流量、影視娛樂、數位影像及物聯網，本週於股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，9月7日旗下子公司格帝控股部分伺服器遭勒索病毒攻擊，導致ERP等資訊系統無法正常運作，資安團隊偵測到異常後，立即啟動防禦機制與斷網隔離措施，採取相關資安應變機制，全面檢視資安系

items.title: N-able一天內發布兩次N-central更新，緊急修補危險程度滿分的重大漏洞
items.summary: IT管理與資安解決方案廠商N-able於9月5日，發布N-central更新2026.3 Hotfix 3（2026.3.1.13），修補了高風險弱點CVE-2026-86206與CVE-2026-86207，CVSS v4.0嚴重程度評分為6.9與7.7，未經授權的攻擊者有機會用於繞過身分驗證機制，得到N-central完整的存取權限，在企業內部網路部署的的N-central系統應立即套用更新，來得到相關防護。

items.title: fix(heartbeat): preserve quiet replies and report committed work (#14…
items.summary: fix(heartbeat): preserve quiet replies and report committed work (#140115) ## What Problem This Solves A scheduled heartbeat that returned reasoning without visible text could trigger a forced-answer retry and send an unwanted channel message. Heartbeat status also lost confirmed message-tool delivery and delegated-work facts, so it could report a quiet result after sending a message or starting a background task. ## Why This Change Was Made Reply preparation now declares that a heartbeat may finish silently. The existing run owner carries confirmed delivery and background-work facts into heartbeat status. Delivery uses the existing channel/account/thread matcher and records an already-sent message without sending it again. Failure, cancellation, ordinary required replies, and task completion retain their existing handling. The change removes the single-use silence resolver and its duplicate helper tests. Heartbeat outcome classification stays with the existing delivery-normalization code. No new configuration or storage schema is added. ## User Impact Quiet heartbeats stay quiet. Real alerts and explicit message-tool sends remain visible. Status distinguishes confirmed delivery and delegated work from a quiet check, including when a later step fails. ## Evidence - Real Telegram Test Server proof on an isolated native Testbox, using deterministic local provider responses and fresh canonical credential readiness for every scenario. - On main `252158295ee4`, a normal scheduled 60-second heartbeat activated the visible-answer continuation and delivered the forced answer. The repaired source made no continuation request, sent no heartbeat message, and stayed quiet through Gateway restart and later observation. - A separate main control reproduced a confirmed message-tool send reported as `ok-empty`/`silent: true`. Fresh independent group validation now observes one explicit send and matching `sent`/`silent: false` status, followed by successful quiet checks and a real alert. - Delayed child and image-generation work remains active and later completes; heartbeat status reports `background-work` rather than an all-clear acknowledgment. - Controls cover `NO_REPLY`, empty output, direct/group delivery, ordinary reply recovery, provider errors, timeout, abort, interrupted tools, a committed partial side effect, ambient policy, configured silence, acknowledgments, and an alternate OpenRouter-compatible provider/model. - Eight producer regression cases fail on main for the original false/undefined silence policy. Bookkeeping regressions also fail on the original source. Focused suites passed 358 tests with one existing skip; the final ownership correction passed all 21 affected tests. Formatting, lint, and changed-file ratchets passed. Independent source review is clean. Preserves @ruel225's contributor commits and credit. Fixes #140052 Independent behavior validation reports 13 passing clauses and no remaining behavior failures. Its three source-only limits cover shared cross-channel ownership, absence of new text/provider filters, and structural cleanup; the complete source review covers those requirements. Configured group-silence behavior was compared against main and is unchanged. Later-send observations are bounded by the retained recordings, including restart. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
